import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int n, k, p, maxVal;
    static int[] popCount = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp2 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp3 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static long mod2;
    static long[][] t = new long[20][Maxn];
    static long[] fact = new long[Maxn];
    static long[] invFact = new long[Maxn];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= p;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % p;
            base = (base * base) % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void precompute() {
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % p;
        invFact[maxVal] = modPow(fact[maxVal], p - 2);
        for (int i = maxVal - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            invFact[i] = invFact[i+1] * (i+1) % p;
    }

    static int nextPowerOfTwo(int x) {
        int power = 1;
        while (power < x) power <<= 1;
        return power;
    }

    static void fwTransform(int[] arr, int len, boolean inverse) {
        long[] buffer = new long[Maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) buffer[i] = arr[i];
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += (step << 1)) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buffer[i + j + step] = (buffer[i + j + step] - buffer[i + j] % p + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += (step << 1)) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buffer[i + j + step] = (buffer[i + j + step] + buffer[i + j]) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            arr[i] = (int)(buffer[i] % p);
            if (arr[i] < 0) arr[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static void adjust(long[] tRow, int s, long val) {
        long x = tRow[s] + val;
        if (x >= mod2) x -= mod2;
        tRow[s] = x;
    }

    static void multiply() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(tmp1[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(t[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            tmp1[popCount[i]][i] = f[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwTransform(tmp1[i], maxVal + 1, false);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxVal; ++s)
                    adjust(t[q + l], s, 1L * tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxVal; ++s)
                tmp3[q][s] = (int)(t[q][s] % p);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwTransform(tmp3[i], maxVal + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            f[i] = tmp3[popCount[i]][i];
    }

    static void squareTransform() {
        int[][] buffer = new int[20][Maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(t[i], 0);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxVal; ++s)
                    adjust(t[q + l], s, 1L * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxVal; ++s)
                buffer[q][s] = (int)(t[q][s] % p);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwTransform(buffer[i], maxVal + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(tmp2[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            tmp2[popCount[i]][i] = buffer[popCount[i]][i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwTransform(tmp2[i], maxVal + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod2 = 1L * p * p;
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(k, n));
            return;
        }
        
        f[0] = 1;
        maxVal = nextPowerOfTwo(n + 1) - 1;
        precompute();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            popCount[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; ++i)
            tmp2[popCount[i]][i] = (int)invFact[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwTransform(tmp2[i], maxVal + 1, false);
        
        int originalK = k;
        while (k != 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) multiply();
            k >>= 1;
            if (k != 0) squareTransform();
        }
        
        long result = (modPow(originalK, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
